title: The Magical Forest
description: A mod that adds a magical forest with gear and mobs
body:
The Magical Forest is a mod that adds a new dimention gear and mobs. The purpose of the Magical Forest mod is to add forests with magical creatures for the player to explore.

The new Magical Forest dimention is home to the Puffler and Puffling mobs. The Puffling is a passive mob that flys around the forest. The Puffler is an agressive mob that will attack all players that come neer it. Killing a Puffler gives the player a Stormy Ingot that can be use to make the Stormy Armour set.
